params._activitySource: The governed instance's direct-vote activity source.
params._avatar: The Safe the module manages (executes as).
params._owner: Governance authority (e.g. a TimelockController) over the module's knobs.
params._scoreSnapshot: The score snapshot that pins params per checkpoint.
params._target: The contract the module calls (the Safe).

setAccumulator(address).details: Mirrors MerkleSnapshot's fail-closed rotation protocol: checkpoint ids have meaning      only within one accumulator history, so a live or pre-used lane cannot be swapped in.      The high-water state is explicitly cleared on the sole safe (both-empty) rotation path.

setAvatar(address).details: Sets the avatar to a new avatar (`newAvatar`).

setTarget(address).details: Sets the target to a new target (`newTarget`).

params.checkpointId: The checkpoint whose inputs the proof consumes.
params.signers: The proven owner set, strictly ascending by address (canonical, unique).
params.targetThreshold: The proven Safe threshold (2 <= targetThreshold <= signers.length).

accumulator().notice: The chained-hash accumulator over the attestation log (source of checkpoints).

activitySource().notice: The governed instance's authenticated direct-vote activity hash chain.

hasAppliedCheckpoint().notice: Whether any checkpoint has been applied (distinguishes "none" from "checkpoint 0").

lastAppliedActivityCheckpoint().notice: Activity history cannot move backwards across accepted score checkpoints.

scoreSnapshot().notice: The score snapshot that pins the PageRank params hash for each checkpoint.

setTarget(address).notice: Can only be called by the current owner.
